description: Jet 4 MDB (two Workspaces): both ws0 (db1) and ws2 (db2) owe a closing commit on one shared file. Phase 1: db1 creates U1 + inserts row 1 (page-1 reservation) and db2 creates U2 + inserts row 2 (page-1 reservation), then db1 closes first and db2 closes last. Phase 2: db1 drops U1 (ReleasedAtClose) and db2 drops U2 (ReleasedAtClose), then db1 closes first and db2 closes last. Phase 3: db1 creates U3 + inserts and db2 creates U4 + inserts, then db2 + ws2 close first while db1 closes last. Keeps all pages before/after every step and Close.
